name: ChatGPT Desktop
where_agents_run: your machine (local checkout or a git worktree per chat) + SSH hosts + OpenAI-hosted Codex cloud chats; your phone reaches the desktop through Remote in the ChatGPT mobile app
license: Closed source; included in every ChatGPT plan: Free $0, Go $8/mo, Plus $20/mo, Pro $100-500/mo, Business $20/user/mo, Enterprise and Edu by contract
source_note: Checked against learn.chatgpt.com (the Codex and ChatGPT desktop app docs that developers.openai.com/codex/app now redirects to), its What's new page, the pricing page, the official download links, and openai/codex GitHub issues for the app shell. Since 2026-07-09 the Codex app ships inside the ChatGPT desktop app. Not installed or run here.

needs_you_signal.value: Notifications plus a waiting-on-you activity list

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approve in the chat or from the phone app

cross_provider_delegation.value: Subagent threads shown; only Codex agents

always_on_assistant.value: Always-on cloud agent; still rolling out

conversation_gui_view.value: Chat view with diffs and subagent threads inline

real_terminal.value: Chat only; its terminal is for your own commands

session_organization.value: Projects holding chats; optional worktree per chat

prompt_scratchpad.value: Editable queue of follow-ups; no drafts area

saved_prompt_library.value: Skills and scheduled prompts; no saved-prompt list

builtin_editors_browser.value: Built-in browser, diff editing, pull request view

appearance_control.value: Themes, colors, separate interface and code fonts

usage_hud.value: Token counts; plan limits and resets only on the web

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Linear issues and pull request reviews; runs in the cloud

worktree_management.value: Creates and cleans up a worktree per chat

planner_orchestrator.value: Splits a task across subagents when asked

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Subagents report to their parent; not chat to chat

knowledge_base.value: Memories and project instructions; no notes store

phone_no_new_app.value: Cloud tasks in a phone browser; local ones need the app

remote_ssh.value: Runs chats on hosts from your SSH config

voice_input.value: Dictation with cleanup, plus spoken conversation

languages.value: Closed source; its Rust app server is open source

background_process.value: Yes: a Codex app server process

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app plus a server)

runs_in_terminal.value: Own app window; Codex CLI is a separate tool

license_cost.value: Proprietary; free tier + paid ChatGPT plans

extensibility.value: Plugins, skills, MCP servers, hooks and an SDK

teams_multiuser.value: Business and Enterprise workspaces with admin
